lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 9 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is wider in the posterior section (approx. 50-60 pixels) and narrows significantly toward the anterior shoulder region (approx. 20-30 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Four mid-torso lines terminate abruptly mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral fringe or the dorsal line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots observed on the lower lateral haunch; density is low and localized.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: The two haunch spots are aligned on a horizontal geometric axis parallel to the ground.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Lyrate horns with a 45-degree posterior-lateral divergence from the skull base, transitioning into a vertical terminal vector.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: 1.45:1 ratio of tip-to-tip distance relative to the combined width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: 0.12 of the total horn length consists of high-contrast ivory tipping.

other_distinctive_markers: Long, dark ventral fringe of hair extending from the lower neck to the inguinal region; white chevron visible on the nasal bridge.
